# Rim theme source

- Source: <https://github.com/Rimseg/typora-theme-rim>
- Pinned commit: `f0d54efe7ec8e81a989bf1e8faad0637ce49c5af`
- Upstream file: `rim.css`
- Upstream theme license: not specified

`rim.css` is an unmodified source snapshot retained for local comparison and
traceability. It is not included in WeiSome application resources or packages.

WeiSome adapts only article-content rules to Compose preview styles and inline
HTML export. Bundled fonts, the page background, writer width, scrollbars,
sidebar, focus mode, quick open, preferences, and other Typora-only rules are
not applied. Code-block colors continue to come from WeiSome's selected code
theme.
